files.original_docstring:
Freeze the selected MIA/AIA candidates into validator-ready attack packages.

The script intentionally reads ``token.txt`` only while constructing the ZIP.
Neither the token nor a token digest is written to ``run.json`` or any tracked
file.  Candidate CSVs and ZIPs live under ignored directories.

files.meaning: S3のcell-modal AIA回答を生成する。
S4で標的ごとに異なるAIA expertを割り当てる。局所実験と提出設定を区別する。
files.original_docstring:
Build the bounded S4 nearest-decoy MIA + multiplex AIA probe.

This script performs the local H1a/H1b sanity check, freezes one formula
before public scoring, creates one deterministic AIA assignment, and writes
candidate CSVs for the target router.  It never reads the Team 10 token and
never creates a ZIP or submits to Codabench.

files.meaning: S5の固定KDE対象3標的とAIA multiplexを構築する。
files.original_docstring:
Build the predeclared S5 server probe without changing prior artifacts.

S5 is a fixed information probe.  It restores the frozen MIA source on every
target except the three predeclared rare-KDE columns, and evaluates exactly one
new AIA expert cell for each target.  The script performs all source and
destination checks before creating the final run directory and never submits.

files.original_docstring: Build reproducible S0/S1 server probes from the target routing manifest.

予備戦の公式1NN回答とgate付きdonor-modal回答を生成・比較する入口。
files.original_docstring: Run AIA stage-2 abstention/donor-set experiments and public candidates.

files.original_docstring:
Run stage-2 cross-fit/null-calibrated MIA experiments and build a candidate.

This script never reads a token and never creates a ZIP/submission.  Public C
files are used only after method selection has been completed on pseudo tune.

files.meaning: S1-dualで提出した固定NN/ExtraTreesブレンドを作成する。
files.original_docstring:
Run Stage-4 categorical-aware classifier MIA diagnostics.

No token, ZIP, or final candidate is read or written.  The runner evaluates a
fixed classifier/gate set on disjoint pseudo tune/test cohorts and writes only
ignored diagnostics under ``attack_phase/outputs``.

files.meaning: 公式1NN、重み付き近傍、modal-window等のAIA基礎実装。
files.original_docstring:
Stage-1 AIA attacks: block nearest-neighbour and time-window variants.

The official attack uses a sex-by-prefecture nearest neighbour over five
continuous QI columns and copies one ``time`` value.  This module keeps that
baseline frozen and adds deterministic, metric-aware variants.  It contains
no hidden membership labels; evaluation helpers operate only on supplied
member/control proxy cohorts.

files.meaning: membership gateとdonor-modal、棄権sentinelを実装する。
files.original_docstring:
Stage-2 AIA: metric-aware abstention and risk-stratified donor sets.

This module deliberately does not use a population predictor on a gate miss.
The abstention sentinel is finite and non-negative but outside the observed
time range, so it cannot accidentally count as a ±0.5-year success.

files.meaning: L1/Huber等の距離を用いるAIA expert群。S4/S5の依存。
files.original_docstring:
Stage-3 AIA robust-distance experiment.

Stage 2's abstention and donor-modal objective are frozen.  This module only
changes the distance geometry used for the C-vs-background membership gate
and for the donor ranking.  The baseline geometry is the Stage 2 normalized
L2 calculation, which is kept here as an explicit rollback configuration so
that every trial can be compared with the frozen candidate.

files.meaning: 生存時間を考慮したAIA expert群。独立実験全体の採用を意味しない。
files.original_docstring:
Stage-4 AIA: survival-aware conditional time attacks (hypothesis H3).

Stage 2's ``gated_abstain_donor_modal`` stays the frozen rollback.  The
membership gate, the abstention sentinel, the block/donor pools, and the
official +/-0.5 objective are all unchanged.  The single axis this stage varies
is *how a time is chosen inside the gate*: an empirical donor modal window is
replaced by a conditional distribution from a cause-specific Cox model fit on
the target ``C``.

The defense calibrated ``time``/``onset``/``death`` with cause-specific Cox
calibration and outcome-triplet swaps, so ``C`` may reproduce the conditional
law ``P(time | QI)`` of ``B`` much more faithfully than it reproduces any
individual record.  ``time`` is administratively censored (most rows sit on a
single follow-up plateau), so the observed-time law is a continuous event part
plus an atom at the plateau; both parts are modelled explicitly here.

No external survival package is required: the Cox fit is a small, auditable
Newton-Raphson with Breslow tie handling and a fixed ridge penalty.

files.meaning: 集団・セル単位の時間推測を提供する依存実装。
files.original_docstring:
Stage-5 AIA: aggregate / reconstruction-style feasibility (hypothesis H4).

The defense matched marginals, categorical profiles, rare profiles and Cox
coefficients to ``B`` very closely, so ``C`` may over-describe ``B`` at the
*aggregate* level even where no individual near-copy survives.  ``time`` is
continuous, so a binary reconstruction attack cannot be ported directly.  This
module therefore asks the feasibility question first, exactly as the Goal
requires, instead of building a large constrained optimisation.

The decisive quantity is an **oracle cell ceiling**.  Any attack whose
prediction is constant inside an aggregation cell — every group-count,
group-mean, group-quantile, histogram, constrained-least-squares or
nonnegative-reconstruction variant of H4 — cannot beat the ceiling obtained by
choosing each cell's single best time with the true member labels revealed.
If that ceiling does not clear the frozen Stage-2 donor attack, no member of
that family can, and H4 is closed by construction rather than by search.

Two concrete aggregate estimators are also evaluated so the ceiling is not the
only evidence.

files.meaning: 時間窓と転帰の意味を補正したAIA expert群。
files.original_docstring:
Corrective H3 AIA estimator: single-event Cox and true window mass.

Stage 4's gate, sentinel, donor pools, and rollback path are preserved.  This
module changes only the in-gate time estimate.  It fixes two semantic issues:
``onset`` and ``death`` are collapsed to one ``any_event`` indicator, and the
window center is selected from a support-complete candidate set rather than
only from the observed time grid.

files.meaning: S3で使ったcell-modal推測等を実装する。
files.original_docstring:
Corrective H4 feasibility bounds for cell-constant AIA attacks.

Stage 5 is retained as historical evidence, but its observed-grid and
member-only ceiling were not a true oracle for the official time objective.
This module keeps the Stage-2/3 gate, sentinel, and cell fallback fixed while
enumerating all relevant continuous sliding-window centers.  The feasible
family is deliberately limited to one constant prediction per resolved cell;
per-row constrained reconstruction is outside this bound.

files.meaning: 予備戦MIAの距離特徴と低FPR評価を定義する。
files.original_docstring:
Inspectable low-FPR membership-inference experts.

This module intentionally keeps each expert observable.  It does not infer
hidden membership labels from the public targets; calibration uses only a
held-out slice of ``A_bg`` and experiment evaluation uses explicit proxies or
pseudo targets with known construction.

files.meaning: 性別×県のBlock NNと参照・較正分離を実装する。
files.original_docstring:
Stage-2 low-FPR MIA calibration and narrowly gated needle experts.

The stage-1 block-nearest-neighbour score remains available as a frozen
baseline.  Stage 2 repeats disjoint reference/calibration fits, aggregates
their evidence, and calibrates the aggregate on a separate meta-null.  Public
targets never provide labels or tuning feedback.

files.meaning: 難易度補正・shadow生成等を提供する依存モジュール。手法全体を採用した意味ではない。
files.original_docstring:
Stage-3 MIA record-difficulty normalization.

Stage 2's frozen Block-NN score remains the rollback baseline.  This module
adds a deliberately small, inspectable challenger: score each candidate
against target-independent shadow targets made from a disjoint A_bg pool and
subtract the candidate's typical shadow score (its record difficulty) from the
target score.  The shadows are fixed before pseudo tune/test evaluation, so
the method cannot learn from membership labels.

files.meaning: NNとExtraTreesの固定比率ブレンドを実装する。
files.original_docstring:
Stage-4 categorical-aware classifier density-ratio MIA.

The Stage-2 single-split Block-NN score is deliberately kept as the frozen
rollback baseline.  This module adds two small, inspectable classifiers that
estimate the density ratio between a pseudo target ``C`` (positive class) and
an A_bg reference (negative class).  Continuous columns are standardized and
categorical columns are one-hot encoded for logistic regression; ExtraTrees
uses deterministic ordinal encoding.  Classifier outputs are calibrated only
against an independent null frame and are never fit on pseudo tune/test rows.

files.meaning: 近傍decoyを想定した距離式の比較を提供するS4ビルダー依存。
files.original_docstring:
Distinct-distance-shell MIA experts for the S4 nearest-decoy probe.

The frozen MIA pipeline uses the same block-wise standardized geometry as
``LowFPRFeatureModel``.  This module changes only which distinct distance
shell is used for the relative score.  Shell membership is defined by unique
finite distances, never by the second row returned by an argsort, so exact
ties cannot make the result depend on CSV order.

files.meaning: MIAは標的列、AIAはtarget_kで回答を結合し、キー整合性を点検する。
files.original_docstring: Target-wise composition of already validated attack candidates.

files.meaning: 既存候補の県補正を追加し、静的・プライバシー制約を点検する。
files.original_docstring:
Extend the deterministic prefecture overlay from prefix 10 to prefix 62.

This script keeps the current best candidate's non-prefecture columns and
replaces only its prefecture column with the deterministic prefix overlay
derived from the original prefix-0 candidate.  It writes checkpoint files,
runs selfscore plus the fixed full-static and local privacy audits, and picks
the highest-U_gen checkpoint that passes every requested gate.

files.meaning: 静的10属性で元Bとの距離・完全一致・希少近傍リスクを点検する。
files.original_docstring:
Full-static nearest-record privacy audit for candidate C files.

This reproduces the disclosed fixed audit: A_bg moments for numeric z-scores,
categorical mismatch weight 2, B_practice as members, and 1,049 controls
sampled from A_bg with ``default_rng(0)``.  Only aggregate diagnostics are
written.

files.meaning: 公式参照攻撃を用いる候補監査。未知の攻撃に対する安全保証ではない。
files.original_docstring:
Local privacy proxy audit for submitted C candidates.

This is deliberately a *proxy* audit.  It reuses the kit's disclosed attack
and scoring functions, but it is not the CodaBench/final attack evaluation.
Only aggregate values are emitted; per-row confidence values never leave
memory and are not written to disk.

Example::

    uv run python experiments/local_privacy_audit.py         --dist ../../_private_team10         --c ../../_private_team10/C_seed4.csv            ../../_private_team10/C_perturb_fixed_k005_s1.csv

files.meaning: 変更県数を限定したprefix探索を行う。
files.original_docstring:
Minimal one-row prefecture rebalancing sweep for the current final C.

Only ``prefecture`` is changed.  Rows are selected from prefecture-surplus
groups, excluding rows flagged by the disclosed rare detector and ranking by
large standardized static distance from B (with an extra distance guard for
the true-rare B members).  Prefix candidates k=1..12 are written and scored.

files.original_docstring: Greedy privacy-aware extension after outcome-swap round 2.

files.meaning: 多数群・公開検出希少群を分け、相関を保った共変量と競合リスク転帰を合成する初期生成器。
files.original_docstring:
条件付きカテゴリ＋無正則化 Cox を使う fully synthetic 防御の実験CLI。

公式の防御実装は変更せず、このファイルだけで次を実行する。

* ``aligned``: B 全体の連続値を Gaussian copula から再合成する。
* ``rare_aligned``: 公開 Mahalanobis 検出器で分けた2群をそれぞれ再合成し、
  整形後の検出件数を rejection sampling で B と一致させる。
* sex/smoking は B で学習した標準化ロジスティック回帰から条件付きに生成する。
* time/onset/death は採点側と同じ予測子変換を使う無正則化 cause-specific Cox
  から条件付きに生成する。

既定の ``--mode all`` は、2モード×seed 0..4 を生成し、各結果を公式 selfscore
（``--json``）で採点する。入力 B の行や record_id は出力へコピーしない。

files.meaning: Cox係数とハザードを較正し、合成共変量へtime/onset/deathを付与する。
files.original_docstring:
Indirectly calibrate fully synthetic outcomes to the official Cox utility.

The static synthetic covariates are built once with ``rare_aligned``.  For each
fixed pair of onset/death uniforms, the onset generator coefficient vector is
updated toward the Cox coefficients fitted on B.  No B row, record_id, or
observed individual time is copied to an output row.

This experiment deliberately changes only ``time/onset/death``.  Therefore the
reference continuous-covariate MIA input is invariant within a covariate seed;
all finalists still require a separate AIA audit.

files.meaning: 多数群ALT等の分位点を部分的に移動して周辺分布を改善する。
files.original_docstring:
Run common-only marginal quantile micro-tilts and official selfscores.

The public Mahalanobis detector is applied to both B and the submitted base C.
Only C rows outside the detector region are changed.  For one selected
continuous column, each common C value is blended toward the matching empirical
quantile of the public-detected common B values.  Rare rows are checked for
bitwise equality and the detected rare count must remain unchanged.

files.meaning: KSの律速列だけを少数セル変更で補正し、監査条件を確認する。
files.original_docstring:
Search and validate minimal common-only KS corrections on round5 final C.

The seven corrections change one continuous value in a public-common row and
cross every tied maximum of that column's empirical CDF discrepancy.  The
search evaluates every subset of size 0..5 with the cached Cox FastSpec
(cache cleared because these are static-column changes), then officially
scores the top three subsets at each size and applies the privacy audits.

files.meaning: 転帰モデルの係数を座標探索してU_specを較正する。
files.original_docstring:
Derivative-free outcome calibration on a fixed fully synthetic static table.

The static columns are read from a submitted C only.  ``time``, ``onset`` and
``death`` are deliberately excluded from the input read and are regenerated
from B-fitted cause-specific Cox baselines plus fixed seed-15 uniforms.  The
first stage evaluates at most 100 candidates with the official U_spec scorer;
only the best eight guarded candidates receive the full official selfscore.

files.meaning: 転帰較正パラメータを小範囲で調整する。
files.original_docstring: Small second-stage seed-15 outcome search around a coordinate-search winner.

files.meaning: time/onset/deathの三つ組を交換し、転帰整合性を保ちながらCox指標を改善する。
files.original_docstring:
Outcome-triplet swap hill climb on a fixed static candidate.

This search deliberately keeps the static columns fixed.  The first phase
swaps complete outcome triplets only inside the public-common, onset-event
bucket.  Such swaps preserve every public rare/common outcome marginal and
all onset/death statuses while still changing Cox risk sets and coefficients.

files.meaning: 合成静的属性を構築し、転帰生成seedを比較する。
files.original_docstring:
rare_aligned の静的共変量を固定した outcome-only seed sweep。

covariate seed=0 で ``rare_aligned`` の連続値・sex・smoking・prefecture を一度だけ
完全合成し、その静的表へ outcome seed=0..9 の cause-specific Cox サンプリングだけを
適用する。生成・整形・公式 selfscore は ``run_aligned_synth.py`` の実装を再利用する。

既定では ``--dist`` の直下へ ``C_rare_cov{covariate_seed}_o{seed}.csv``、``scores/``
へ公式 JSON を書き出す。covariate_seed=0 の既存命名はそのまま維持する。B の行・
record_id・token は出力へコピーしない。

files.meaning: 県の周辺分布を調整し、U_genの律速を緩和する。
files.original_docstring:
Match the prefecture marginal while breaking row-level associations.

The official utility scorer uses ``prefecture`` only through its marginal TVD
and the no-fabrication group checks.  Reference AIA, in contrast, uses it as a
blocking key.  This experiment therefore copies only the aggregate category
counts from B, randomly permutes that multiset, and assigns it independently to
an already synthetic C.  No record identifiers or row correspondence are used.

files.meaning: 希少群SBP等の周辺分布を限定的に修正する。
files.original_docstring: Search tiny rare-profile corrections on the validated round6 candidate.

files.meaning: 希少属性の複合方向の微小補正でU_rareを改善する。
files.original_docstring:
Compose rare-tilt micro-sweep candidates on a fixed safe outcome base.

The rare-tilt files are generated separately by ``run_rare_truth_tilt.py``
from the original pre-tilt base.  This script overlays only the seven
continuous columns on the public-detector rare rows onto the current safe
candidate, then selfscores and runs fixed full-static/privacy proxy gates.

files.meaning: 加工者に配布された自Bの希少ラベルを用い、希少領域の分布を補正する。
files.original_docstring:
Apply a shrinkage-only true-rare marginal tilt to synthetic rare rows.

The input is already fully synthetic.  Only rows detected as rare by the public
Mahalanobis rule are adjusted, and only through monotone marginal quantile
shrinkage toward B_self's true-rare distribution.  Joint row combinations and
all outcomes remain synthetic.  A vectorized line search keeps every adjusted
row inside the public rare region, so the detected rare mass is unchanged.

This is an experiment, not a privacy claim.  Because the transform uses a small
24-record reference group, every selected candidate must pass membership and
attribute-inference audits before packaging.

files.original_docstring:
Build CL01 exploratory candidates S3/S4/S5 for the main attack phase.

MIA: 971407 confidences as E0, structural layer from structural_attack.py.

files.meaning: 972302の基礎となる県事前確率と希少順位の構造層。自Bのis_rareを利用する。
files.original_docstring:
CL01 structural attack layer (Claude, 2026-10-09).

Design facts used (rulebook §3.1 + verified on released preliminary truth):
  * P_i (313 non-shared rows) is drawn from the team's home prefecture; every AIA
    challenge row of a target is in that target's home prefecture.  Preliminary
    truth: 315/319 home-prefecture rows of B10 are non-shared.  Main B14 has 343
    Hyogo rows for 313 P rows, so P(shared | home) ~= 30/343 = 0.087.
  * Every non-home row is shared with exactly one other cohort.
  * MIA power per target = max(TPR@1%FPR over all candidates, same over the 24
    rare candidates).  The rare channel is decided by the top of the 24-row
    rare ordering, which can be set independently of the all-channel slots.

MIA: keep an existing per-pair confidence matrix E0 for the all channel (with a
home-prefecture log prior), and reorder only the rare candidates inside their
existing all-channel slots by E0 + w * E1, where E1 is the record-wise
peer-normalised log 1-NN distance on the seven continuous columns.

Inputs are lawful only: own B (incl. our own is_rare), A_bg, released C_k and
challenge QIs.  Truth files are read only by the scoring helpers for the
preliminary world.
